title: Performance, Security, and Production Engineering
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of performance, security, and production engineering in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 20: Performance, Security, and Production Engineering. Lessons in order: Understanding Swift Performance; Algorithmic Complexity; Optimizing Collections and Data Processing; Optimizing SwiftUI Applications; Concurrency Performance; Memory Performance and Profiling; Secure Coding Principles; Network and API Security; Application Privacy; Configuration and Secrets Management; Reliability and Fault Tolerance; Production Readiness and Maintenance.
